text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
………… "Excessive fluid intake is bad for 
the skin." ...Just as bad as dehydration, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see... Indeed—lately... I may have been 
drinking too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of excessive drinking(?), 
Symboli Kris S's skin seemed to be 
breaking out.
